name: City tour · Tiradentes
note: approxMinutes e lookAt são estimativas iniciais: ajuste depois de um tour real.

stops.name: Mirante / Alto São Francisco
stops.transition: Now let's walk down into the gold.
stops.lookAt: o cruzeiro de 1718 e a Serra de São José no horizonte

stops.name: Largo das Mercês / Estrada Real
stops.transition: This street was the highway of gold.
stops.lookAt: a Capela das Mercês e o calçamento da Estrada Real

stops.name: Ponte de pedra

extras.title: Bafômetro do mineiro
extras.joke: This is the Minas breathalyzer. If you scrape it, you had one cachaça too many.

extras.title: Cachaça
conferir: Alambique ligado à família de Tiradentes em Coronel Xavier Chaves (citado no tour).

stops.transition: Below us, enslaved men panned gold for 80 years.
stops.lookAt: o talha-mar da ponte e o córrego Santo Antônio

stops.name: Largo das Forras

extras.title: Os passinhos
bullets: Stations of the Senhor dos Passos

stops.transition: Forras means freed women. They bought freedom selling food here.
stops.lookAt: as figueiras, os jardins de Burle Marx e a capela do Bom Jesus da Pobreza

stops.name: Subida “passinho de procissão”
stops.transition: Walk slowly, like a procession. I need time to tell you about a civil war.
stops.lookAt: a ladeira de pedra (subir devagar, contando)

stops.name: Beco da Pedreira

extras.title: O quinto do guia
bullets: Find gold here? Pay the Fifth
extras.joke: If you find gold, 20% goes to the guide. It's called the Fifth. It's tradition.

stops.transition: This alley is where you see how the gold actually came out.
stops.lookAt: o barranco de argila com veios de quartzo

stops.name: Vista da serra (perto do Gourmeco)
stops.transition: In 1718 this camp became a town. Then the bill came.
stops.lookAt: a Serra de São José inteira

stops.name: Museu Padre Toledo
stops.transition: The conspiracy started at a baptism party. Right there.
stops.lookAt: fachada do casarão, janelas do segundo andar

stops.name: Igreja de São João Evangelista
stops.transition: Here's where the 'paradise of the mulattos' quote gets complicated.
stops.lookAt: a fachada da igreja dos pardos

stops.name: Beco da Matriz
stops.transition: Two cities in one: power above, servitude in the alleys.
stops.lookAt: os respiradores de senzala no muro

stops.name: Poço da Matriz

extras.title: Poço do PIX
bullets: The 1710 well, now a wishing well
extras.joke: I'm installing a Venmo wishing well. Coins are so 1995.

stops.transition: The well that built the church. And three kids who invented a wishing well.

stops.name: Matriz de Santo Antônio

extras.title: Ler a igreja
bullets: Oculus and wind door: natural light
Column with four ages of woman

extras.title: Terreno santo
bullets: Ceiling shaped like a coffin lid
conferir: Instrumento legal que proibiu sepultamento nas igrejas em 1828.

extras.title: Casar na Matriz
extras.joke: The waiting list is so long, you book the church first and find the groom later.

stops.transition: 482 kilos of gold. Let's talk about why.
stops.lookAt: o altar-mor, o órgão e o relógio de sol

stops.name: Beco do Rosário / Largo do Rosário

extras.title: A cadeia em frente
bullets: Passinho do Encontro: Mass for prisoners

stops.transition: The church of the Africans. And the jail they put right across the street.
stops.lookAt: a igreja do Rosário e a antiga cadeia

stops.name: Rua Direita / Quatro Cantos

extras.title: Sobrado × solar
extras.joke: Colonial Instagram: sit by the window and watch the feed.

extras.title: Pedras de amarrar cavalo
bullets: Stones for tying horses at corners
extras.joke: Colonial valet parking. Like forgetting where you parked at Walmart.

stops.transition: Commerce downstairs, family upstairs. That's a sobrado.
stops.lookAt: os beirais e as janelas dos sobrados

stops.name: Chafariz de São José

extras.title: Fim do tour
bullets: Spur the mule, fill the belly
extras.joke: Time to spur the mule and fill the belly.

stops.transition: And here's the fountain. Drink at your own risk. It's how I got stuck in time.
stops.lookAt: o oratório com São José de Botas e as três carrancas
